# Phase 5 — Forms (decoupled steps)

> Goal (per `docs/05_ROADMAP.md`): fill, create, and manage interactive
> PDF forms (AcroForm). XFA gets read-only degraded support only.

## Acceptance demo (from roadmap)

- ~~Fill `tests/fixtures/acceptance/p5-irs-w9.pdf` (real IRS W-9)~~ — **skipped by
  decision, 2026-08-10.** The fixture was never added. Superseded by the in-app
  sweep (`P5-SWEEP.md`), which covered fill / create / properties / export /
  import / flatten, plus a three-reader check on the flattened output.
  **Known gap:** every form exercised was generated by `scripts/generate-sweep-form.py`
  — our own script, from the same assumptions as the code. Nothing has been run
  against a complex form authored by other software. `Sample PDFs/corpus/` holds
  candidates (`012-libreoffice-form`) if this is ever revisited.
- Create a new form with 8 fields of mixed types. Export filled data → re-import
  to a blank copy → fields restored identically. **Done** in the sweep: 8 fields
  built by hand, exported to all four formats, re-imported to a blank copy
  (7 built-ins restored; the hand-built names correctly reported unmatched).

## Spec coverage

`P5-FORM-001` through `P5-FORM-010` (10 spec lines). Plus 1 infrastructure step.

---

## Track A — Form detection & filling

### P5.A1. `[x]` Detect AcroForm + Form-mode entry point
- **Spec:** P5-FORM-001
- **What:** On open, inspect the AcroForm dict; if present, surface a "Form mode" button with field count.
- **Test:** `src-tauri/tests/form_detect.rs`.
- **Depends on:** P1.B1.

### P5.A2. `[x]` Fill text fields
- **Spec:** P5-FORM-002
- **What:** Type, Tab navigation, respect max-length and multi-line flags.
- **Test:** `src-tauri/tests/form_fill_text.rs`.
- **Depends on:** P5.A1.

### P5.A3. `[x]` Fill checkbox / radio
- **Spec:** P5-FORM-003
- **Test:** `src-tauri/tests/form_fill_checkbox.rs`.
- **Depends on:** P5.A1.

### P5.A4. `[x]` Fill choice fields (combo, list)
- **Spec:** P5-FORM-004
- **Test:** `src-tauri/tests/form_fill_choice.rs`.
- **Depends on:** P5.A1.

### P5.A5. `[x]` XFA degraded support
- **Spec:** P5-FORM-005
- **What:** When the PDF is XFA-only (no AcroForm fallback), display "XFA editing not supported" and offer "Convert XFA to flat content (read-only)."
- **Test:** `src-tauri/tests/form_xfa_degraded.rs`.
- **Depends on:** P5.A1.

---

## Track B — Form authoring

### P5.B1. `[x]` Create text field
- **Spec:** P5-FORM-006
- **What:** Drag in form-edit mode. Config: name, default value, max length, multi-line, required.
- **Test:** `src-tauri/tests/form_create_text.rs`.
- **Depends on:** P5.A1, P2.A1, P2.A3.

### P5.B2. `[x]` Create checkbox / radio (grouped) / combo / list / signature / push-button
- **Spec:** P5-FORM-007
- **Test:** `src-tauri/tests/form_create_other.rs`.
- **Depends on:** P5.B1.

### P5.B3. `[x]` Tab order + field property editor
- **Spec:** part of P5-FORM-006/-007 (UX completeness)
- **What:** Drag-reorder tab sequence. Per-field property panel.
- **Test:** `src/tools/form-author/__tests__/tab-order.test.ts`.
- **Depends on:** P5.B2.

---

## Track C — Data interchange

### P5.C1. `[x]` Export form data (FDF / XFDF / JSON / CSV)
- **Spec:** P5-FORM-008
- **Test:** `src-tauri/tests/form_export.rs`.
- **Depends on:** P5.A2 + A3 + A4.

### P5.C2. `[x]` Import form data + Flatten
- **Spec:** P5-FORM-009, P5-FORM-010
- **What:** Import matches by name; unmatched fields reported, type mismatches reported (never silently coerced). Flatten renders each field's current appearance into page content and removes the interactive definitions.
- **Test:** `src-tauri/tests/form_import.rs`, `src-tauri/tests/form_flatten.rs`.
- **Depends on:** P5.C1.

---

## Suggested order

P5.A1 → P5.A2 → P5.A3 → P5.A4 → P5.A5 → P5.C1 → P5.C2 → P5.B1 → P5.B2 → P5.B3
